claims.claim: In an observational before-and-after review, breast density rose by at least one category in 62.5 percent of 107 women ages 34 to 79 who used GLP-1 receptor agonists including Ozempic and Wegovy for weight loss for at least a year.
claims.episode_span: Specialized software showed breast density up by at least one BI-RADS category in 62.5 percent of participants
claims.source_title: Study finds increased breast density and callbacks among women taking GLP-1 drugs
claims.supporting_quote: Specialized software showed that breast density increased by at least one category in 62.5% of participants; eight women moved up two categories.

claims.claim: Those 107 women lost between six and 107 pounds, averaging 40 pounds, and researchers reviewed 214 screening mammograms.
claims.episode_span: Participants lost between six and 107 pounds, with an average loss of 40 pounds, and the reviewers looked at 214 mammograms.
claims.source_title: Study finds increased breast density and callbacks among women taking GLP-1 drugs
claims.supporting_quote: Participants lost between six and 107 pounds, with an average loss of 40 pounds. Researchers reviewed 214 screening mammograms taken before and after at least a year of treatment.

claims.claim: The findings are scheduled for presentation at the Radiological Society of North America annual meeting in Chicago from November 29 to December 3, 2026, and have not yet been peer-reviewed for a journal.

claims.supporting_quote: The research is being presented next week at the annual meeting of the Radiological Society of North America but has not yet been peer-reviewed for publication in a medical journal.
